Scroll marker SVG use `fill="var(--black)"`. Change to white in CSS or JSX.

### Option 1: CSS (best, one place)

Add `fill` property to `.scroll-marker` in [ScrollIndicator.css](file:///home/gaitano/01-studio/01-src/eugene-gaitano/frontend/src/components/ScrollIndicator/ScrollIndicator.css#L16-L20):

```css
.scroll-marker {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: -12px;
  fill: var(--white);
}
```

CSS rule override SVG `fill` attribute. All pages update.

### Option 2: JSX attribute

Change `fill` on `<svg>` directly in [Home.tsx](file:///home/gaitano/01-studio/01-src/eugene-gaitano/frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx#L89) and [Resume.tsx](file:///home/gaitano/01-studio/01-src/eugene-gaitano/frontend/src/pages/Resume.tsx#L344):

### Problem 1: `vite-plugin-glsl` installed in wrong folder

Package installed in project root, not `frontend/`. Vercel run `npm install` inside `frontend/`. Plugin missing.

Run command inside `frontend/`:

```bash
cd frontend
npm install -D vite-plugin-glsl
```

```bash
rm package.json package-lock.json
```

### Problem 2: `vite-env.d.ts` in wrong path & uncommitted

[tsconfig.app.json](file:///home/gaitano/01-studio/01-src/eugene-gaitano/frontend/tsconfig.app.json#L25) only scan `"src"`. `frontend/vite-env.d.ts` outside `src`. TypeScript ignore it.

Move file inside `src/`:

mv frontend/vite-env.d.ts frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts

```bash
cd frontend
npm run build
```

Build pass. Commit untracked files and push to remote for Vercel:

git add frontend/

Boolean flag. Default `false`.
